final_text: I've set the white box down upright on the blue square, opened the jaws and raised them about 10 cm above it. In the last camera frame it sits squarely on the square, covering almost all of it, with a thin strip of blue showing along the side nearest the arm.

I set the white box down upright on the blue square, let go, and lifted the open jaws about 15 cm above it. From that height, the last camera view shows the box sitting flat on the blue square with blue visible around its edges.

The first attempt to grab it stalled with the jaws resting on top of the box, so I opened them all the way and went down again. The second try gripped it.

The white box is sitting upright on the blue square, the gripper has let go, and the jaws are about 15 cm above the table, clear of it. The last camera view shows the box upright with blue showing around it. From that angle I couldn't confirm it's exactly centred: it may be a little toward the far edge of the square, but it does sit on it.

The white box is standing upright on the blue square, the gripper is open and the jaws are lifted about 13 cm clear of it, though the box may sit about a centimetre off-centre toward the square's far edge (my estimate from the final camera view).
